text:
infra-bot: alert: 12 GPUs in pool redwood-eu-west-1-gpu reported kernel errors after driver rollout at 01:42 UTC :warning:
alex_m: seeing TRT/DLA failures when loading engines, lots of `cudaErrorLaunchFailure` and `invalid device function` in logs. affected pods restart loop.
mei_chen: impacted services: /generate (llama-2), streaming chat bots that use FlashAttention-optimized kernels, and one reranker with xFormers kernels.
sanjay_patel: NCCL also spiking with timeouts between two nodes, getting `NCCL WARN Call to allGather timed out` in system logs.
julie_ops: rolling back nodes? how many nodes to drain to stop scheduling while we triage?
alex_m: 3 nodes in the gpu-pool are erroring hard (g4dn-like instances). kubectl logs show:
```
E tensorflow: cuda_driver.cc:xx] failed to allocate texture memory: invalid device function
E TRT: EngineParser: failed to create execution context: cublasLt returned 7
Segmentation fault (core dumped)
```
mei_chen: this smells like a kernel/driver ABI mismatch with compiled kernels (FlashAttention / TRT kernels built against previous driver). we just pushed driver 536.33.02 last night from 535.54.03.
sanjay_patel: confirmed on a repro container: `python -c "import torch; import flash_attn; flash_attn.ops.fwd(...)"` errors with `invalid device function` on sm_86 GPUs.
dino_buildbot: CI flashattn wheel test matrix failing on cuda 12.1 + driver 536 (repro pipeline ran).
julie_ops: rolling back nodes? how many nodes to drain to stop scheduling while we triage?
alex_m: 3 nodes in the gpu-pool are erroring hard (g4dn-like instances). kubectl logs show:
```
E tensorflow: cuda_driver.cc:xx] failed to allocate texture memory: invalid device function
E TRT: EngineParser: failed to create execution context: cublasLt returned 7
Segmentation fault (core dumped)
```
mei_chen: this smells like a kernel/driver ABI mismatch with compiled kernels (FlashAttention / TRT kernels built against previous driver). we just pushed driver 536.33.02 last night from 535.54.03.
sanjay_patel: confirmed on a repro container: `python -c "import torch; import flash_attn; flash_attn.ops.fwd(...)"` errors with `invalid device function` on sm_86 GPUs.
dino_buildbot: CI flashattn wheel test matrix failing on cuda 12.1 + driver 536 (repro pipeline ran).
julie_ops: plan: cordon affected nodes, move critical pods to fallback pool (cpu/gpu-old-driver), and open a rollback to 535.54.03 in eu-west-1. who owns the nodepool rollback? ops-oncall? @sanjay_patel can you coordinate? :thumbsup:
sanjay_patel: I can start rollback. will drain 3 nodes now: `kubectl drain node/gpu-eu-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` then re-image with driver 535.54.03 image.
alex_m: temporary app-level mitigation: add model routing rule to route high-traffic endpoints to dedicated old-driver pool + enable CPU fallback for low-priority batch jobs.
mei_chen: long-term: we need automated kernel-compatibility smoke tests in infra CI: build small TRT/FlashAttention artifacts and run on new driver images before rollout. file bug with NVIDIA about missing backwards compatibility for some kernels compiled with older nvcc.
dino_buildbot: I've queued a canary job that builds flashattn with CUDA 12.1 + nvcc flags `-gencode=arch=compute_86,code=sm_86` and runs quick kernels. will post results.
julie_ops: who should we notify for customers in that region? sales/support? this might affect 2 enterprise tenants.
alex_m: ping support + account leads. add opt-out for scheduled jobs. capacity hit estimated ~28% until rollback finished.
sanjay_patel: rollback in progress. ETA 22 minutes for first node reprovision. will update when first node healthy.
mei_chen: quick debugging tip: setting `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST` to include additional arch codes helped on one box (recompile wheel + restart). not great as emergency step.
dino_buildbot: canary build finished: flashattn wheel built against new driver fails with `invalid device function` during kernel launch. wheel built against old CUDA/driver passes. attaching logs in incidents ticket.
julie_ops: rolling back pool completed for the three nodes. monitoring CPU/GPU utilization and pod evictions.
alex_m: after rollback, one of the previously failing TRT services came back healthy. no more segfaults on that node.
sanjay_patel: NCCL timeouts cleared after nodes rejoined with older driver. network NVLink health ok.
mei_chen: next steps: 1) add driver->kernel compatibility gate to infra rollout playbook, 2) add flashattn/TRT quick smoke to image build, 3) open formal ticket with NVIDIA/TensorRT + flashattn maintainers, include kernel traces and exact driver revisions.
julie_ops: I'll create the postmortem and tag eng-runtime/eng-infra/eng-ml. include customer impact and capacity delta.
alex_m: FYI: avoid reapplying 536.x until vendor responds. tagging @security to confirm no CVE concerns.
sanjay_patel: last update: all affected workloads in eu-west-1 are stable on rolled-back image. keeping nodes cordoned until we validate canary build. closing this thread after postmortem doc is up. :white_check_mark:
